text:
You have an existing Wix website and Google Ads campaign that are generating some leads, but need structured optimization, proper tracking setup, and hands-on guidance on Google Analytics and Tag Manager.

My name is Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboards, data cleaning, and data visualization, with a strong focus on SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. For a project like yours, I can work with you session by session, sharing my screen and walking you through what needs to be adjusted in the campaign, how to improve measurement, and how to make sure the setup supports better decision-making.

I’ve worked on Google Analytics and tracking projects where accurate setup was critical. For Verdant Skincare, I built a tracking plan and GTM setup to move the shop from Universal Analytics to GA4, mapping 46 events and maintaining no gap in year-on-year reporting. That project reinforced how important clean event tracking and a well-structured implementation are before trying to optimize performance.

I also completed a Marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare, where I joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit. The result was 18% of ad budget reallocated and customer acquisition cost down 12% the next quarter. That experience is directly relevant to understanding which campaigns are contributing to leads and where optimization efforts should go.

I’m comfortable working in an interactive, consulting style and can help you through the practical steps of setting up and improving Google Ads-related measurement, including Google Analytics and Tag Manager. Since your site and campaign are in Russian, I should be transparent that I am not a native Russian speaker. If that is still suitable for your needs, I’d be glad to discuss your current setup and help you improve it on an hourly basis.

If everything works, I’d be happy to start with a review of your current campaign structure, tracking, and goals.
